scenarioResolutionOutcomes._notes: Success = expedition advanced / relic recovered / threat escaped; loss = defeated, mind-wiped, or time unravelled. Exploration scenarios (Untamed Wilds, Boundary Beyond, Heart of the Elders 1 and 2, Depths of Yoth) treat every numbered resolution as a win since each just records how far you got before escaping — only no_resolution (resign / agenda out) is a loss. Doom of Eztli R1/R3 both = relic recovered + escaped (win); no_resolution_defeated = loss, no_resolution_resigned = neutral (voluntary early exit). Threads of Fate judged R1=win / no_resolution=loss (act completed vs time-out) rather than omitted, to match every other scenario's no_resolution=loss. City of Archives confirmed by db: had_memories_expunged carries outcome:loss, so no_resolution=loss, R1 (escaped/resisted)=win. Shattered Aeons grounded in db outcome flags: R1 mended-tear, R2 saved-serpents, R3 saved-Yithians = win; R4 fabric-of-time-unwoven = loss; R5 turned-back-time = neutral (the secret rewind branch into the alternate finale, deliberately not a clean win nor a defeat, and the only Shattered Aeons resolution with no db outcome flag); no_resolution=loss. Turn Back Time (alternate finale, no widget): R1 sealed-relic-forever carries outcome:win/best, no_resolution=loss.

_notes: Verified against tfa-en.draft.json and tfa-db.draft.json. Span "the Harbinger" is an exact substring of "the Harbinger is still alive (#X# damage)." and is the only Harbinger/count-style sibling in campaign_notes, so blurring leaves it distinguishable ("is still alive (#X# damage)."). No sibling collisions: Alejandro/Harlan/Relic of Ages/Eztli are front-loaded in the prologue and left visible (rule 3); Ichtaca is an early recurring companion left visible to keep siblings distinct; Serpents/Yithians faction pairs (investigators_saved_serpents/investigators_saved_yithians, cooperated_with_yithians) differ only by the faction noun so it stays visible (rule 2). nexus/depths/tear in time/fabric of time are generic endgame scaffolding, each the sole sibling of its kind, so left unblurred. The en draft contains ONLY campaign_notes entries, so no hidden-section bookkeeping entries to drop. Supplies roster: the published tfa-en/db and rttfa references do not enumerate the items, so the 11-item list is taken from the canonical TFA prologue supplies step (Provisions x2 and Medicine x2 are the multiple-allowed ones). Labels/ids verified internally consistent; none are spoilers (visible prologue section). No changes needed.

supplies._note: Recorded per investigator under each investigator's 'Supplies' section. Purchased in the prologue 'supplies' input with supply points (points array by player count: [10,7,5,4]). cost = supply 'cost' field. repeatable maps to the prologue 'multiple' flag (Provisions, Medicine only). All item ids, labels, costs, and repeatable flags verified against prologue.json and tfa-db.json.

yigs_fury._note: Campaign-wide 'Yig's Fury' counter (campaign.json section title 'Yig's Fury', type 'count'). Accumulates across scenarios. No fixed cap in the reference; achievement 'bane_of_yig' infers logCount min 25 and 'dont_tread_on_me' infers logCount max 0, so it can range from 0 upward with no max set. Not per-investigator.
